title: Avoid empty params array allocation

title: Avoid Enumerable.Count() on a countable collection
message: '{0}.Count()' enumerates the sequence. Use the Count or Length property instead.

title: Avoid ToList before foreach
message: 'ToList()' materializes the sequence only to iterate it. Iterate the source directly.

title: Avoid string concatenation inside loops
message: String concatenation inside a loop allocates a new string per iteration. Use StringBuilder.

title: Avoid capturing the loop variable in a closure
message: The lambda captures the loop variable '{0}', allocating a closure on every iteration. Copy the value into a local before creating the delegate.

title: Avoid reading the system clock on a hot path
message: '{0}' reads the system clock on a hot path. Inject TimeProvider and call GetUtcNow instead.

title: Avoid Enum.HasFlag boxing
message: Enum.HasFlag boxes its argument on older runtimes. Use a bitwise comparison instead.

title: Avoid the default comparer for a struct without a generic comparison interface
message: '{0}.Default' boxes every comparison of struct '{1}' because it does not implement {2}. Implement the generic interface or provide a custom comparer.

title: Avoid Substring allocations for parsing and comparison
message: 'Substring' allocates a new string. Use a span-based overload or AsSpan instead.

title: Prefer GeneratedRegex over new Regex
message: 'Regex' is constructed at runtime. Use [GeneratedRegex] to generate the matcher at compile time.

title: Avoid foreach over a non-generic collection of value types
message: foreach over the non-generic IEnumerable boxes every '{0}' element. Use a generic collection instead.

title: Avoid ToLower/ToUpper for comparison
message: '{0}' allocates a new string. Use StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase instead.

title: Avoid LINQ inside loops
message: LINQ inside a loop allocates enumerators and delegates on every iteration. Use a manual loop or move the query out.

title: Avoid Task.Run inside async methods
message: 'Task.Run' inside an async method adds a thread-pool hop without doing CPU-bound work. Await the operation directly.

title: Avoid async void
message: '{0}' is async void. Exceptions cannot be observed. Return Task instead.

title: Avoid blocking on tasks
message: '{0}' blocks the calling thread and can deadlock in a synchronization context. Await the task instead.

title: Avoid enumerating an IEnumerable more than once
message: '{0}' is enumerated more than once in '{1}'. Materialize it once or use a concrete collection.

title: Avoid awaiting a ValueTask more than once
message: '{0}' is awaited more than once in '{1}'. Convert it to a Task first or await it once.

title: Avoid Task.FromResult on hot paths
message: 'Task.FromResult' allocates a new task on every call. Cache the completed task or return a value directly.

title: Avoid Array.Resize inside loops
message: 'Array.Resize' copies the whole array on every call. Use a List<T> or ArrayPool<T> instead.
